tool.name: Cosmic Ray
tool.execution_environment: two sequential disjoint WSL shards followed by a complete database merge

dependency_refresh.reason: RASTER-PATH-STROKE-P17 changed raster_renderer.py and superseded the prior PathDrawing join rejection contract
dependency_refresh.method: P17 preserved straight-edge primitive joins, composed the P15 fast witness into its 579-item campaign, and reran the P15 condition and full suites before re-attesting the hashes.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: The outer-side test changes from cross > 0 to cross >= 0.
premises: The immediately preceding guard returns when cross == 0.
Every value reaching the side expression is therefore strictly positive or strictly negative.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: For every reachable cross value, cross > 0 and cross >= 0 have the same truth value, so the selected normal side is unchanged.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: The short-polyline guard changes from len(points) < 2 to len(points) < 1.
premises: The predicates differ only for exactly one point.
One point produces zero adjacent segment pairs.
The closed seam is a repeated point and is skipped; every join has equal incident points and emits no shape.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: Both versions perform zero Pillow calls and return the same transparent result for the only differing input cardinality.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: Closed following-index normalization changes from (i + 1) % n to (i + 1) - n.
premises: Closed join indices satisfy 0 <= i < n.
Python negative indices k - n select the same element as nonnegative index k for 0 <= k < n.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: For i < n - 1, (i + 1) - n is the negative index of element i + 1; for i == n - 1 both expressions select zero. Every following vertex is identical.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: The helper's round selector changes from line_join == round to line_join >= round.
premises: Live validation restricts non-miter helper calls to round or bevel.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: On the complete reachable set, equality with round and greater-than-or-equal to round are true only for round.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: An outer polygon miter equality changes to object identity.
premises: Equal interned values take the unchanged legacy route.
An equal non-interned miter value may take the outer else route.
That route passes the same value to _draw_polygon, which re-evaluates it with value equality and takes the same legacy line operation.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: Both outer routes converge on the same scaled vertices, fill, stroke, width, and legacy miter draw call for every equal miter string.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: The private helper signature changes closed from keyword-only to positional-or-keyword.
premises: Every reachable caller supplies closed by keyword.
Both signatures accept the same closed keyword and bind it to the same boolean value.
The helper is private and signature introspection is outside the rendering contract.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: The mutation only admits additional positional call syntax; it does not change binding or execution for any production call.
